_comment: Cross-SDK parity for the dataset `key` on the wire. Pushing Dataset(display_name, key=dataset_key) must send `key` = dataset_key on the dataset upsert, and pulling a dataset whose response echoes that key (under a DIFFERENT display name) must adopt it -- so a case added to the pulled dataset gets `added_case.id`, byte-identical in Python and TypeScript and identical to authoring that case locally.
